name: LiveMCPBench
description: LiveMCPBench evaluates large-scale multi-server Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool usage by testing 95 real-world daily tasks with a suite of 70 servers and 527 tools. It measures the ability of agents to perform tool retrieval and composition in complex multi-tool environments, using an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation framework to verify task outcomes.
reputation: An emerging benchmark for agentic tool use over MCP servers, with interest likely to grow as MCP adoption expands, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Includes a large-scale, reproducible tool suite and an LLM-based judge to handle dynamic data and multiple valid solutions; highlights retrieval as a major bottleneck.
